resources.string: An astronomical compass to find celestial objects, explore their paths and view models and lunar phases.

Designed for use on Earth: the app uses gravity and Earth’s magnetic field for orientation; GPS provides location. These references do not guarantee reliable orientation in space with an ordinary smartphone. With more advanced space technology and sensors, perhaps one day we will find our way up there too 🙂
Reduced accuracy means the phone reports low magnetic calibration. Pointing remains approximate until sensor accuracy improves.
Maps are reference images, not live photographs. Original licenses and attributions are included in the app.
Choose the app theme to customize how the content looks.
